Welcome to the new site. The old one dated from early grad school and had started to feel like someone else's homepage, so I rebuilt it from scratch — still [Quarto](https://quarto.org), now with a hand-rolled theme.

A few things I'm deep in at the moment:

- **Segmentation benchmarking.** Comparing cell segmentation algorithms for Xenium data across a multi-organ mouse atlas, and building [CRISP](../../software.qmd) to measure segmentation purity without ground truth.
- **Spatial pipelines.** Nextflow and Seurat workflows that take Xenium runs from raw output to annotated cells reproducibly.

I plan to use this blog for short, practical posts — the kind of thing I wish had existed when I was googling the same error message for the third time. If that sounds useful, check back soon.
